title: Springfield Symphony: An American Hymn
seo_title: Springfield Symphony: An American Hymn in Springfield, MO
description: This is a symphony concert of religious works by great American composers, inviting reflection on the sacred and holy. The program includes Bernstein's Chichester Psalms with the Combined University Choirs, Copland's Appalachian Spring built around the Shaker hymn Simple Gifts, and Jessie Montgomery's Starburst, a sparkling fanfare. It takes place Saturday, February 13, 2027 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
